contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE ; D/ D N VALEN

A copper-alloy nummus of Valens, AD364-378. Mint is Lyon, AD364-367, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE. Reverse shows Victory advancing left. Obverse shows pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads D N VALEN - [...]. Reverse fields and exergue read: OF I//LVGP[...].
